product_metadata.title: Nourished Essentials Fermentation Kit - 3-Pack Airlock Fermentation Lids for Wide Mouth Mason Jars with Vacuum Pump - Air Lock for Fermenting Kimchi, Sauerkraut, and Kombucha
features: Ferment with Confidence: Join our Fermenting Club for expert guidance, recipes, and support. Our fool-proof kit includes ebooks, videos, and a Q&A forum to ensure your success.
Original Quality: Beware of imitations. Our stiff, durable plastic fermentation lids with a thick, leak-proof gasket are the real deal. Accept no substitutes.
Effortless Fermenting: Our easy fermenter lids release gas while keeping mold and bacteria out, with a built-in date dial and pull tabs for easy opening. No burping or messy airlocks required.
Easy Cleaning: Our air lock for fermenting kit has parts that easily separate for thorough cleaning, including under the date dial. All food safe and BPA-free.
Risk-Free Purchase: Made in the USA, our kit includes 3 fermentation lids compatible with wide mouth jars and a vacuum pump for easy air removal. If not satisfied, we offer money-back guarantee.
